STEP 4. Check connector C-58 at ECM <M/T> or connector 
C-55 at PCM <A/T> for damage.
Q: Is the connector in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 5.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection (P.00E-2). Then go to Step 14.
STEP 5. Check for open circuit and short circuit to ground 
between throttle position sensor connector B-07 terminal 4 
and ECM connector C-58 terminal 42 <M/T> or PCM 
connector C-55 terminal 46 <A/T>.
Q: Is the harness wire in good condition?
YES : Replace the ECM or PCM. Then go to Step 14.
NO : Repair it. Then go to Step 14.
STEP 6. Check the continuity at throttle position sensor 
harness side connector B-07.
(1) Disconnect the connector B-07 and measure at the harness 
side.
(2) Measure the continuity between terminal 1 and ground.
• Should be less than 2 ohm.
Q: Is the continuity normal?
YES : Go to Step 9.
NO : Go to Step 7.
